info.name: SmartRetail API - FR1 to FR5
info.description: Every FR1-FR5 endpoint of the SmartRetail backend. Fill adminPassword and workerPassword (collection Variables tab) with SEED_ADMIN_PASSWORD / SEED_WORKER_PASSWORD from your .env, then run the whole collection in order with the Collection Runner. Requests save ids into collection variables for later requests. See docs/API_Endpoints_FR1-FR5.md.
